create_lighton_ocr_config: create a LightOnOcrConfig with custom vision and text settings for the LightOnOCR-1B model
build_lighton_ocr_processor: build a LightOnOcrProcessor that tokenizes text prompts and processes input images for OCR
run_lighton_ocr_forward: run the LightOnOcrModel forward pass to extract image features and generate language outputs
generate_lighton_ocr_text: generate text from LightOnOcrForConditionalGeneration conditioned on input images
build_multimodal_projector: build a LightOnOcrMultiModalProjector that projects vision features into the text embedding space
